memory_candidates.content: When a Lean inductive Formula type Lukasiewicz-encodes and/or/neg as abbrev expansions into nested imp/bot, a tableau/proof-search rule dispatch that pattern-matches those encoded shapes will emit obligations for DEEP subformulas. A truth/completeness lemma over such a type cannot be proved by structural `induction phi` or by `induction` on a well-formedness proof (both give only immediate-subformula IHs). Use strong/well-founded induction on a complexity measure instead; a robust encoding is a fuel-bounded `_aux` lemma proved by `induction n` (plain Nat.rec) with the public lemma instantiating n := phi.complexity, avoiding Mathlib well-founded-recursion lemma-name hunting.
